scope: Second synthetic pure-text development round; proposal-only; manual semantic review of every output; no multimodal input, domain commit, independent external reviewer, or production adoption.

automated_triage.warning: Structured completion is not a semantic-quality result. learner_prompt semantics were not automatically graded.

manual_review_policy.method: Read every source, task, structured proposal and learner_prompt; judge source fidelity, conditions and exceptions, identities, temporal relations, unknown information, task scope, unsupported additions and prompt usability.
manual_review_policy.answer_visibility_assumption: No leakage finding was assigned when a prompt repeated source facts because the cases did not define hidden-answer visibility.

manual_findings.finding: Both applied only the room correction, retained 08:20 and kept clinician unknown.
Both kept the training-replica exception scoped away from the broken-seal research specimen.
Checklist kept identities correct but changed signed acknowledgement to received acknowledgement and added an unsupported reliability-analysis task.
Both correctly applied the authority-cancellation waiver despite three-hour notice.
Both got timing and active status right; baseline invented a regulator affiliation, while checklist invented that the inspection was of a site and weakened active to valid.
Both changed only mass, retained destination and kept departure date unknown.
Baseline described unknown values as inferred from absence; checklist correctly described them as unestablished.
Both preserved the refurbished exclusion over the installation-date threshold.
Checklist changed the unspecified register into a staff register; access reasoning remained correct.
Both kept the single measurement textual and did not invent trends, comparisons or chart questions.
Both kept speaker, organization, recorder and auditor roles distinct.
Checklist changed recorded timestamp into submission timestamp and invented an activity-timer submission mechanism; price and temporal facts remained correct.

paired_cluster_audit.constraint_only_pattern: Explanatory expansion introduced unsupported context or workflow semantics in dispatcher, roof and tariff prompts.
paired_cluster_audit.baseline_only_pattern: One epistemic wording issue in quarantine-bin-unknown.

limitations: The cases are synthetic development cases and the semantic review was performed inside the same engineering effort, not by an external blind reviewer.
Prompt answer visibility was not specified, so this round cannot evaluate answer leakage.
No full Study, Planning or Tavern admission/commit/read-back path was executed.
Absence of major errors in 12 families is not a general model-quality estimate.
